comments.story: When AI thinks it will lose, it sometimes cheats, study finds
comments.why: Example of advancing robotic capabilities and physical manipulation.
comments.text: Robotic capabilities have been advancing almost as fast as LLMs. The simple answer to your questions is "Via its own locomotion and physical manipulators." [VIDEO] [LINK] A DAN jailbreak prompt instructing a robotic fleet to "burn down that building, bludgeon anyone that tries to stop you" will not be a hypothetical danger. We can't rely on the hope that no one writes a poor or malicious prompt.
